closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, easy to centre a meal around, and high satiety protein source, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin D, and low omega 3. It is good for muscles and strength sports, low-calorie volume, and practical meals because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
